fato_historico: 1860: The Second Opium War finally ends at the Convention of Peking with the ratification of the Treaty of Tientsin, an unequal treaty.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to navigate complex dialogues with grace. Just as historical tides eventually shift toward resolution after long periods of tension, you may find that persistent misunderstandings finally reach a peaceful conclusion. It is a good time to express your multifaceted thoughts and seek harmony in your connections, allowing your brilliant mind to shine through every conversation.
frase_do_dia: True peace comes from the balance of honest words and open hearts.
significado_numero: Represents the closing of old chapters and the beginning of new wisdom.
conselho: Consider listening more than speaking to truly understand the people around you today.
